key_insight: Atomic MathReasoner improves mathematical reasoning by selecting a problem-specific composition of specialized atomic-skill experts.
engineering_relevance: A lightweight router selects precomputed LoRA compositions at inference, avoiding costly online composition optimization.
method: Train capability-specific LoRA experts and discover low-loss composition prototypes through gradient-free optimization on held-out validation subsets.
Score prototypes using reference-solution token-level negative log-likelihood and filter ambiguous assignments with a confidence margin.
Distill the resulting pseudo-labels into a router that selects a composition for each problem.
evidence_signal: On AtomicMath with Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, average field accuracy rose from 64.4% to 68.1% at Level 1 and 59.3% to 63.7% at Level 2; average logical reasoning performance rose from 39.4% to 46.8%.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether the learned compositions and router generalize beyond AtomicMath.
paper_title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
